sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Advertising Business - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Alright, let's keep Ragman's advertisements going! Next up, the Banshee or the A18 Skanda plate carrier. Pick whichever you like more. Just don't forget to win. Nobody looks at losers."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Win 10 matches while wearing a Banshee or A18 Skanda plate carrier

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +7,700 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.01
- 75,000 Roubles
- 30 GP coins
- 1× Lega Medal
